text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... This is... the dawn of fortunate

prospects...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh... Trainer... But of course I am...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Time and time again, all of my
predictions
brought me "great
misfortune." It won't surprise
you to hear
that my hands were shaking as I held
the
crystal ball...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However, in my morning divination
session, the
result read "slightly modest
fortune"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I've been sacrificing my sleep these past
few days
to win some good luck, and
now fortune shines
upon me... And with
such overwhelming
brightness...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's like a warm, fuzzy feeling inside of me... Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru is sleepy for the rest
of the
day.
